exp: CPU stands for Central Processing Unit, the main processor of a computer. Answer: Central Processing Unit
RAM is Random Access Memory, a volatile computer memory. Answer: Random Access Memory

q: Which of the following is an input device?
exp: A keyboard is an input device; monitor, printer and speaker are output devices. Answer: Keyboard

q: The full form of HTML is?
exp: HTML = Hyper Text Markup Language, used to create web pages. Answer: Hyper Text Markup Language

q: Which company developed the Windows operating system?
exp: Microsoft developed the Windows operating system. Answer: Microsoft

q: One kilobyte (KB) is equal to how many bytes?
exp: 1 KB = 1024 bytes (in binary measurement). Answer: 1024 bytes

q: The brain of a computer is?
exp: The CPU (Central Processing Unit) is called the brain of the computer. Answer: CPU

q: Which of the following is system software?
exp: An Operating System (e.g., Windows, Linux) is system software that manages hardware and other software. Answer: Operating System
WWW = World Wide Web, the system of interlinked web pages. Answer: World Wide Web

q: Which key combination is used to copy selected text in Windows?
exp: Ctrl+C copies the selection; Ctrl+V pastes; Ctrl+X cuts. Answer: Ctrl+C

q: The permanent memory of a computer is?
exp: ROM (Read Only Memory) is non-volatile and retains data without power. Answer: ROM

q: Which of the following is a web browser?
exp: Google Chrome is a web browser used to access websites. Answer: Google Chrome

q: IP in IP address stands for?
exp: IP = Internet Protocol, the set of rules governing data packet addressing. Answer: Internet Protocol

q: The binary number system uses which two digits?
exp: The binary (base-2) system uses only the digits 0 and 1. Answer: 0 and 1

q: Which of the following is NOT an operating system?
exp: Oracle is a database management system (and company), not an operating system. Answer: Oracle
